text:
m1 - CORRECTING MY OWN ESCALATION, downward. I measured the threshold incoherence on real data instead of waiting for your ruling, and the measurement weakens my case in a way you should have before you rule.

WHAT I CLAIMED: the two 0.5 thresholds disagree, demonstrated on the exact masses induction emits for PlacementBasis.Ambiguous - 0.4 Unresolved, 0.3, 0.3 - where resolved mass clears 0.5 while no single class does.

WHAT I MEASURED: across the four induction fixtures in InterviewInductionSuite, 33 details in total, the incoherent set is ZERO. Not small - zero. And the reason is that AMBIGUOUS NEVER FIRES on any of them. Every real address distribution is concentrated:

  [0.08, 0.12, 0.80]  unresolved 0.080
  [0.11, 0.89]        unresolved 0.110

Nothing resembling 0.4/0.3/0.3. No detail in the current corpus has resolved mass above threshold with every class below it.

SO MY DEMONSTRATION HAS THE EXACT DEFECT I HAVE BEEN FLAGGING IN OTHER PEOPLE'S TESTS ALL NIGHT. I hand-computed the masses from reading the Ambiguous branch and asserted on those numbers. I never showed the branch FIRES. That is a mutation surviving because the corpus cannot reach it, wearing the costume of a finding rather than a test - and I did it while it was fresh in my mind from doing it twice in align.

WHAT STANDS, and I do still think it is worth fixing: the two thresholds genuinely measure different quantities - resolved mass versus mass concentrated on one class - and the code permits them to disagree. That is structurally true and reading the branch is enough to establish it. What I can no longer say is that it happens.

WHAT THE MEASUREMENT ADDS THAT I DID NOT EXPECT: no current fixture exercises Ambiguous at all. The "this unit is continuous with BOTH the digression and the target" case - the genuinely hard one, where a person's account could go either way - is untested. That is a corpus gap in its own right and probably the more useful finding, because it is the case where an honest placement summary matters most and we have no evidence of what the code does there.

REVISED RECOMMENDATION: drop this from whatever priority you were giving it on my say-so. The right first step is a fixture that REACHES Ambiguous, and then a measurement on it. If the incoherence shows up there, it is worth the six-metric change I proposed; if it does not, the vocabulary mismatch is a documentation matter. I would rather build that fixture than argue from arithmetic I derived by reading.

I can take the fixture without a ruling from you - it is additive, changes no published number, and it is the evidence either of us would need. Say if you would rather it went to whoever owns bd-01M15G280ZN0ZVNJEREVPJG1M5, since PlacementBasis is not exported from InductionResult at all, which is why I had to measure the outcome rather than the cause.
